tspan.tspan: Even if, over the course of a lifetime, I
— and after fifty years, had managed to save only a single life ...
wouldn’t that still have been worth all the effort

text.tspan: In my opinion wealth is not mesured in money
but in number of rescued lifes...
... even if i fail my whole life to save
lifes in 99% of the cases and after 50 years
... wouldnt in not though be worth the effort?
